hero.title: Full-Stack Developer
hero.description: Full-Stack Developer specialized in JavaScript, PHP, and Python. I build complete solutions, from frontend to observability architectures for critical infrastructure. I developed SIMPOL, an intelligent monitoring platform for Banco Caroní.

history.title: My story
history.content: I'm Julián López Castillo, Computer Engineer awaiting graduation ceremony from the Universidad Nacional Experimental de Guayana (UNEG). I have a motor disability, so I work remotely. I enjoy building complete solutions and solving technical problems with real impact.

environment.title: Work environment
environment.content: I work in a development environment optimized for productivity and accessibility, with custom configurations and static analysis tools that ensure code quality in every project.

focus.title: Professional focus
focus.content: I combine Full-Stack development with a unique perspective on digital accessibility and critical infrastructure observability. My goal is to build systems that work for everyone, with emphasis on user experience and operational continuity.

eduneg.title: Eduneg
eduneg.description: Academic management application with modern architecture, intuitive interface, and responsive design. Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

accountModule.title: Account Movement Module
accountModule.description: Module developed during my professional internship for account movement management, featuring secure transactions and data validation.

simpol.title: SIMPOL
simpol.description: Intelligent permanent online monitoring system for critical physical and virtual servers. Centralizes real-time telemetry, generates automated alerts, and forecasts resource consumption through Capacity Planning models.
